text: An automatic Journals (daily notes) page is created every day at midnight and is the default landing page
quote: Every day at midnight a new Journals page is created with that day's date, making it easy to see when you've added what information.

text: Create/reference pages with [[double-brackets]] and reference individual blocks with ((block refs))
quote: Type `[[]]` to create or reference any other page. You can also make a new page in the search bar. - Type `(())` to reference a block on any page.

text: Run simple structured queries against your notes using the {{query}} macro or /query command
quote: Simple queries by using `{{query }}`, the format is something like this: {{query Something you're looking for}}

text: Browse a marketplace to search, install, update, and remove third-party plugins
quote: Extends the functionality of logseq with third party tools ... third-party plugins from the Marketplace, can be searched, installed, updated and removed.

text: Enable a local HTTP API server to give external tools authorized access to your graph
quote: local HTTP server to access logseq's graph ... Enable HTTP APIs server in `Features > HTTP APIs server`

text: Publish an entire graph or selected pages as a standalone browsable website (single-page app)
quote: This feature publishes a graph as a [[Publish Web]], single page application (SPA).

text: Export your data in multiple open formats: Markdown, HTML, OPML, PNG, EDN, JSON, text
quote: The Logseq Export feature allows users to export their data in various formats, including text, HTML, OPML, PNG, EDN, JSON, and standard Markdown.

text: Whiteboards: place notes, drawings, shapes, embeds, and connectors together on a spatial canvas
quote: Put thoughts from your knowledge base as well as new ones next to each other on a spatial canvas together with shapes, drawings, website embeds and connectors.

text: Sync up to 10 graphs across Desktop, Android, and iOS apps
quote: Syncs up to 10 graphs between Logseq Desktop, Android, and iOS.

text: Quick-capture short text and links via a logseq:// URI, usable as a browser bookmarklet or from the command line
quote: logseq://x-callback-url/quickCapture? ... Quick capture for short text and links. Can be added as a bookmark link to modern browser

text: Community-maintained documentation for building plugins against Logseq's plugin API
quote: This is a community-driven documentation for Logseq plugin APIs.

text: A logseq:// URI protocol lets third-party applications invoke actions inside Logseq
quote: Logseq provides a protocol `logseq://` to allow third party applications to invoke actions within Logseq.

text: Top-level blocks can be converted into a standalone page and back into a block
quote: Blocks that have a page as a parent i.e. usually top-level blocks can be converted to a page and back to a block easily. To convert this block to a page, simply tag the block with `#Page`.

text: Positioned as a privacy-first, open-source knowledge base
quote: Logseq: A privacy-first, open-source knowledge base

text: Developers can sideload unpacked plugins outside the official marketplace for testing
quote: Click on `Load unpacked plugin` to load plugins that are distributed outside the marketplace.

text: Graph sync between devices is end-to-end encrypted so the vendor cannot read it
quote: Yes, your graph is end-to-end encrypted.
